big_case.notes: Pro se paid petition from a per curiam Eighth Circuit affirmance of a pleadings-stage dismissal of a civil-conspiracy suit against federal agencies and private entertainment-industry parties; eight questions presented that restate grievances rather than legal rules; every respondent, including the Solicitor General, waived; denied at the first conference without noted dissent. Stakes confined to the parties, no doctrinal reach, no public reaction.
